📖 How to use

  1. Choose SSS (three sides) or SAS (two sides + included angle).
  2. Enter the known values.
  3. All three sides and all three angles are solved instantly.
  4. Read the area, perimeter and the formulas used below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which inputs do I need?

Either all three sides (SSS) or two sides plus the angle between them (SAS). Those two cases determine a triangle uniquely.

How are the angles computed?

From the law of cosines: for SSS, angle A = arccos((b² + c² − a²) / 2bc). For SAS the third side comes from the law of cosines first, then the law of sines gives the remaining angles.

What if my sides cannot form a triangle?

The tool checks the triangle inequality (each side must be shorter than the sum of the other two) and warns you if the inputs are impossible.
